name: 01-golden-600
notes: The browser runner's own replay golden, as a script the Godot host can be driven by. The seed is 0x5eed1234 and the intents are read from `drive()` in web/lib/sideview-runner/replay.test.ts. Two references sit beside it, which is the pair the browser test already writes: `.web-frames.txt` is one unchained digest per frame, so "which frame moved" is a diff rather than a claim, and `.web.jsonl` is the whole hashed world every twentieth frame, so "and why" is a field diff. The full per-frame state is 1.5 MB and is not tracked; while the browser runner still exists it is one `REPLAY_DUMP=<path> bun test lib/sideview-runner/replay.test.ts` away, and after the port the Godot host's own dump is the golden.
